overfit_counterexample.label: EXAMPLE — NOT A RESULT
overfit_counterexample.source: Independent closed-form synthetic oracle, not a strategy result: eight +1 mean blocks and eight -1 mean blocks; B reverses A means; within each block both have residuals [-1,+1].
overfit_counterexample.all_other_splits: IS winner must be the OOS loser: complement reverses the column means with identical variance.
overfit_counterexample.tie_policy_to_test: IS exact tie: lexicographically smallest stable trial ID; OOS average rank.
overfit_counterexample.integration_status: Implemented and verified by tests/test_033_pbo.py; see T052 red and T055 green logs, 2026-09-22

convention_source: Bailey et al., The Probability of Backtest Overfitting, https://www.davidhbailey.com/dhbpapers/backtest-prob.pdf: ascending rank/(M+1), logit, PBO at logit <= 0. Exact ties: preregistered stable trial-ID IS winner and average OOS rank; fixture tests pin both.
